title: THE CEILING WAS IN THE MEASUREMENT
note: Two-hundred-nineteen-word causal chain. The film celebrates the correction, holds the average relation to the observed 15 mV/m limit, keeps the roughly twofold response near 25 mV/m extrapolated, and states that no operational AI forecast was tested.
